exposure: Hospitals with above-median utilization and success rates of TOLAC
trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 146,185 women with one prior cesarean delivery and a term singleton pregnancy without congenital anomalies or contraindications for TOLAC in California from 2010 to 2012.
finding: Hospital utilization and success rates of TOLAC varied significantly, with an inverted U-shaped relationship between utilization and success, and hospitals with above-median utilization and success having higher risks of certain morbidities but shorter lengths of stay.
